name: Malan van der Walt
title: Psychologist
description: AHPRA-registered psychologist with over 10 years' experience working especially with LGBTQIA+ communities and neurodivergent people, including anxiety, low mood, ADHD, trauma and major life changes. Telehealth across Victoria or in-person in Oak Park.

name: Mark Camilleri
title: Psychologist
description: Queer affirming, discrete and safe counselling. Offers LGBTIQA+ Affirming Support and Trans, Gender Diverse, & Non-Binary Support for young people and families; in Brunswick Wednesdays to Fridays.
specialties: LGBTIQA+, trans, gender diverse, non-binary, young people and families

name: Dr Marcus Squirrell
title: Psychologist
description: We have worked with the LGBTIQ community for many years. Dr Marcus Squirrell also works extensively with the trans community, including WPATH evaluations for members of the trans community requiring gender affirming hormones and surgeries.
specialties: LGBTIQ, trans, gender affirming assessments, WPATH

name: Charlie Dean
title: Psychologist
description: Registered general psychologist based in Melbourne offering telehealth psychology appointments for adults. Charlie incorporates feminist, queer, and decolonial theories into their work, mainly using mindfulness, CBT and ACT.
specialties: queer, LGBTIQ, polyamory, ACT, CBT, mindfulness
